description: Look up the official fax number for a US government form or office (IRS, Social Security, USCIS, VA and more) from FaxUp's directory. Each number was read on the agency's own .gov page and carries that page's link and the date it was checked. Use it to get the number, then send_fax to that number. Read-only; sends nothing.

query.description: What you need to fax or which office, e.g. "IRS Form 2848", "Social Security", "USCIS I-130", "VA records".

name: find_agency_fax_number
title: Find a US government fax number
